# vendor/h6280 — MAME's HuC6280 CPU core, as plain C

`h6280_core.h` is GENERATED by `tools/emu-host/gen_h6280.py` from MAME's
`src/devices/cpu/h6280/h6280.cpp` (license: BSD-3-Clause, copyright-holders: Bryan McPhail; based on Juergen
Buchmueller's 6502 core). The original notice is kept at the top of the generated file.

The transformation is mechanical: the device class's members become file-scope statics with the same names, its
methods static functions, the opcode table an array of function pointers; MAME's memory-space and debugger code is
dropped. `nucleo_pce.c` supplies the memory (1 KB windows over the MPR banks), the VDC port (ST0/1/2), the PSG,
the pad port and the IRQ lines. Do not edit the generated file: change the generator and run it again.

    python tools/emu-host/gen_h6280.py <mame>/src/devices/cpu/h6280/h6280.cpp
